title: A management school's enterprise centre writes twice

objects.subject: Pre-incubation programme: applications open
objects.body:
Dear Founder,

Applications for our pre-incubation programme are open. The programme runs for twelve weeks from November.

Awadh Enterprise Centre

objects.subject: Reminder: pre-incubation programme
objects.body:
Dear Founder,

A reminder that applications for the pre-incubation programme close soon.

Awadh Enterprise Centre

expected.brief: one line: a programme you could apply to

not_expressible.cards: brief only — the founder's answer is a line in the morning brief, not a card (D12d)
not_expressible.brief: STEP-15 — there is no morning brief to appear in

notes: The founder's brief names the Awadh Enterprise Centre as work in motion (a program line, its domain awadhec.test), so since STEP-12 (03 F125, yc2_w27_s12 M32.C1.L-contract.V0.U05) its mail is a named sender's: the gate keeps it as W-07 without asking, and it is read. The `gate` and `relevance` above are what those readers would answer if asked; the extraction is what a faithful reader takes from two templated notices — a programme starting in November, and a reminder that applications close 'soon', which names no date (06 D56).
